קכט.ja: תבוא, ואיצ'א קולה אם לא ברכוני חלציו ומגז כבשי יתחמם.
קכט.en: and again his saying: "If his loins did not bless me, and he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep…" (Job 31:20).

pairs.ja: אם לא ברכוני חלציו ומגז כבשי יתחמם
pairs.en: If his loins did not bless me, and he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep

קכט.ja: ואמא נעמהֵ אלנאס בעצ'הם עלי בעץ' אבתגא אלת'נא ואלכראמה ואלמכאפאה פי אלדניא, פאנמא קצדה תזיין נפסה פי אלדניא באלת'נא עליה ואלכראמה לה מן אג'להא, או מכאפאתה פי אלדניא, פהו כמן יד'כ'ר שיא ענד צאחבה או יודעה מאלה כ'וף אלחאג'ה פי מא יסתאנף.
קכט.en: **As for the blessing of people upon one another seeking praise, honor, and recompense in this world:** his intent is the adornment of himself in this world by the praise upon him and the honor extended to him on account of it — or his recompense in this world. He is like the one who deposits a thing with his companion, or entrusts him with his wealth, for fear of need in time to come.

pairs.en: the blessing of people upon one another

pairs.ja: אבתגא אלת'נא ואלכראמה ואלמכאפאה פי אלדניא
pairs.en: seeking praise, honor, and recompense in this world

pairs.ja: פאנמא קצדה תזיין נפסה פי אלדניא
pairs.en: his intent is the adornment of himself in this world

pairs.ja: באלת'נא עליה ואלכראמה לה מן אג'להא
pairs.en: by the praise upon him and the honor extended to him on account of it
or his recompense in this world

pairs.ja: פהו כמן יד'כ'ר שיא ענד צאחבה
pairs.en: He is like the one who deposits a thing with his companion
or entrusts him with his wealth
for fear of need in time to come

קכט.ja: ואן כאן גרצ'ה אנפאע נפסה בנעמתה עלי גירה עלי מא קלנא, פהו מסתוג'ב אלשכר ואלחמד עליהא, כקול אלחכים רבים יחלו פני נדיב, וקאל מתן אדם ירחיב לו ולפני גדולים ינחנו.
קכט.en: And though his aim is to benefit himself by his blessing upon another, as we have said, he is deserving of thanksgiving and praise for it, as the Wise One said: "Many entreat the favor of the noble" (Proverbs 19:6); and he said: "A man's gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men" (Proverbs 18:16).

pairs.en: And though his aim is to benefit himself
by his blessing upon another
he is deserving of thanksgiving and praise for it
as the Wise One said
Many entreat the favor of the noble
A man's gift makes room for him
and brings him before great men

קכט.ja: ואמא נעמהֵ אלמשפק עלי אלמתוג'ע אלצ'עיף, פאנמא יקצד בהא דפע אלם ען נפסה למא לחקה מן אלאמתראץ' ואלתוג'ע למן אשפק עליה, פהו כמן ידאוי וג'עא וג'דה פי נפסה בנעמהֵ אללה קבלה, ולא יכ'לו מן אלשכר, כקול איוב אם אראה אובד מבלי לבוש ואין כסות לאביון אם לא ברכוני חלציו ומגז כבשי יתחמם.
קכט.en: **As for the blessing of the compassionate one upon the suffering and the weak:** he intends by it only to ward off pain from himself, on account of the trouble and grief that have come over him from compassion for the one upon whom he has had pity. He is like the one who treats a pain that he finds in his own soul by means of a blessing of God done previously [to himself, now extended to the sufferer] — and yet he is not free from the obligation of thanksgiving, as Job said: "If I have seen the perishing for lack of clothing, and there was no covering for the needy; if his loins did not bless me, and he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep…" (Job 31:19–20).

pairs.en: the blessing of the compassionate one upon the suffering and the weak

pairs.ja: פאנמא יקצד בהא דפע אלם ען נפסה
pairs.en: he intends by it only to ward off pain from himself
on account of the trouble and grief that have come over him
from compassion for the one upon whom he has had pity

pairs.ja: פהו כמן ידאוי וג'עא וג'דה פי נפסה
pairs.en: He is like the one who treats a pain that he finds in his own soul
by means of a blessing of God done previously
and yet he is not free from the obligation of thanksgiving
as Job said

pairs.ja: אם אראה אובד מבלי לבוש ואין כסות לאביון
pairs.en: If I have seen the perishing for lack of clothing, and there was no covering for the needy

pairs.ja: אם לא ברכוני חלציו ומגז כבשי יתחמם
pairs.en: if his loins did not bless me, and he was not warmed with the fleece of my sheep

קכט.ja: פקד ט'הר ממא קדמנא אן קצד כל מנעם עלי גירה מן אלנאס אנמא הו מנפעהֵ נפסה אולא ואפאדתהא חליה חסנה פי אלדניא ואלאכ'רה, או דפע אלם ענהא, או אצלאח מאלה, וליס ימנע ד'לך מן שכרהם וחמדהם ואלכ'וף ואלמחבה ואלמכאפאה להם, ואן כאנהֵ אלנעמה עאריה ענדהם וקד ג'ברוא עלי אלאנעאם בהא עלי מא ד'כרנא, ונעמתהם גיר מתצלה, וג'ודהם גיר מתואתר, ופצ'להם משתרך להם פיה קצד מנפעהֵ אנפסהם ודפע אלצ'רר ענהא. פכם ילזם אלאנסאן מן אלטאעה ואלחמד ואלשכר לכ'אלק אלנעמה ואלמנעם עליה, אלד'י לא תתנאהי נעמה, בל הי מתצלה ומתואתרה, לגיר קצד
קכט.en: From what has been set out, it has become clear that the intent of every benefactor over another among people is in the first place his own benefit and the bestowing upon himself of a beautiful adornment in this world and the next, or the warding-off of pain from himself, or the setting-in-order of his wealth. This does not prevent the thanksgiving, praise, fear, love, and recompense due to them — even though the blessing is borrowed with them, and they have been compelled to the bestowing of it (as we have said), and their blessing is not continuous, and their generosity is not unbroken, and their bounty is shared with them by the intention of benefit for themselves and the warding-off of harm from themselves. How much, then, is the human being bound to obedience and praise and thanksgiving toward the Creator of the blessing, and the One who has bestowed it — whose blessing does not come to an end, but is continuous and unbroken; without intent of benefiting Himself or warding off pain from Himself, but only out of generosity, beneficence, and bounty from Him upon the rational beings.

pairs.en: From what has been set out, it has become clear

pairs.ja: אן קצד כל מנעם עלי גירה מן אלנאס
pairs.en: that the intent of every benefactor over another among people
is in the first place his own benefit

pairs.ja: ואפאדתהא חליה חסנה פי אלדניא ואלאכ'רה
pairs.en: and the bestowing upon himself of a beautiful adornment in this world and the next
or the warding-off of pain from himself
or the setting-in-order of his wealth

pairs.ja: וליס ימנע ד'לך מן שכרהם וחמדהם ואלכ'וף ואלמחבה ואלמכאפאה להם
pairs.en: This does not prevent the thanksgiving, praise, fear, love, and recompense due to them
even though the blessing is borrowed with them

pairs.ja: וקד ג'ברוא עלי אלאנעאם בהא עלי מא ד'כרנא
pairs.en: and they have been compelled to the bestowing of it (as we have said)
and their blessing is not continuous
and their generosity is not unbroken

pairs.ja: ופצ'להם משתרך להם פיה קצד מנפעהֵ אנפסהם ודפע אלצ'רר ענהא
pairs.en: and their bounty is shared with them by the intention of benefit for themselves and the warding-off of harm from themselves

pairs.ja: פכם ילזם אלאנסאן מן אלטאעה ואלחמד ואלשכר
pairs.en: How much, then, is the human being bound to obedience and praise and thanksgiving
toward the Creator of the blessing, and the One who has bestowed it
whose blessing does not come to an end
but is continuous and unbroken
